messages:
elaine: Quick accessibility pass request — can folks skim the Model Activity side rail in the Figma link? small PR incoming but want to catch any keyboard/ARIA/contrast nits before I open it. https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/model-activity-rail :eyes: maria: I looked through the frame. Two immediate things: the token-count badge is low contrast on the green background (ratio ~3.1:1). Need >=4.5:1 for body text. Also the focus ring on the collapsed 'Rollouts' accordion is pretty subtle when you tab into it. pavel: re: focus ring — I can change the outline to `3px solid #0057D9` for high contrast. Will that be okay? Also keyboard nav currently skips the small chevron button inside the panel header; we should make the entire header `role=button` with `tabindex=0` so it's focusable rather than relying on the tiny hit target. maria: `3px solid #0057D9` sounds good for contrast. For the token badge, two options: (1) darken the badge to `#0B7A4A` which brings ratio to ~5.0:1, or (2) keep current hue and switch the token text to bold + `#092F20` (also hits ~4.6:1). Prefer option 1 visually but either is fine. elaine: leaning toward option 1 (darken badge). Pavel can you drop both variants so UX can pick? Also add an accessible label on the badge — screen readers only see "Badge 123" atm. Something like `aria-label="Active tokens: 123"`. pavel: yep will add both CSS variants and aria-label. Quick CSS I plan to add:```css /* variant A: darker badge */ .token-badge { background: #0B7A4A; color: #ffffff; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 8px; } /* focus-visible for keyboard users */ .panel-header:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0057D9; outline-offset: 2px; } /* make header keyboard-accessible */ .panel-header[role="button"] { cursor: pointer; } ``` sam: tiny copy nit for screen readers — when the accordion expands we should announce the number of active rollouts. Use an `aria-live="polite"` region update like: "Rollouts expanded. 2 active rollouts". That avoids surprise for VoiceOver. maria: agree. Also for the collapsed state add `aria-expanded="false"` on the header and toggle to `true` when expanded. For the chevron icon, add `aria-hidden="true"` so assistive tech doesn't read "chevron" every time. pavel: implemented aria-expanded toggle & aria-hidden on chevron in branch. Also fixed keyboard skip by making the chevron non-focusable and delegating keypress Enter/Space on the header element. Quick snippet I used:```html
Rollouts ▾
...
``` access-audit-bot: Automated contrast check results: token-badge variant A (#0B7A4A on white text) PASS (AA large and normal). panel-header focus color #0057D9 PASS (contrast 7.2:1). 2 other minor issues: low-contrast placeholder in search input, and missing `lang` attribute on the embedded SVG used for status icons. maria: Thanks bot. Placeholder fix = bump placeholder color to `#6A6A6A`. For SVGs, add `role="img"` and `aria-label` or `` inside SVG. elaine: Great — pavel can you open the PR with both badge variants + the focus and ARIA changes, and include a short QA checklist in the description: keyboard tab order, VoiceOver announce for expand, contrast check, SVG aria/title? I can then get UX to pick final badge color and we can merge. :thumbsup: pavel: will do, PR later today. thx all!
